method: Circular mean of two directly reviewed opposite projected boot-extension/recovery stances, using interval midpoints. Independent of the existing SW number.
anatomical_note: Near/far track projected painted legs, not reconstructed anatomical/world-floor contacts. Painted edge samples have unquantified anatomical/recovery/occlusion correspondence uncertainty.
baseline_ambiguity: Existing approved SW17 contains an additional near-support motif and another late opposite-leg pose at15. Frame8 was chosen for the corresponding recovery silhouette. One phase offset cannot make all old/new poses or foot positions equal.
limitations: Exact physical foot contact/zero-slip not proven
Same distance phase does not remove painted foot/body position differences
Actual run/fire and S/SW transitions require production main.tscn review
